interpretedRequirement: Reassess the architecture around available dual microphones: identify who speaks when, use this to separate overlapping speech, then transcribe each speaker. Pause failed activity-head tuning; preserve the ordinary baseline.

previousModelWorkpoint.next: 继续原RM-OVERLAP，优先取得小批真实中文近场耳麦/远场混音配对，核对同一会议、说话人/声道、时间对齐和耳麦串音，再用每个人的参考音检查当前分离到底丢了什么。已核实AliMeeting官方提供近远场，AMI可作第二语料。完成配对参考验证前不扩大训练、不再重跑两个失败活动小头或换同类权重。数据可靠后只适配被实测定位的模块，并以未训练会议逐人漏字/串话/插入、普通语音不退步决定去留；最后再做完整会议、纪要事实和双端实卡。

recommendation: Refactor the audio input and processing stages around preserved synchronized microphone channels. First evaluate a diarization-first guided multi-channel separator before investing in further model training. This is a feasibility recommendation, not evidence that two microphones already meet accuracy targets.
keyFindings: Normal board recording currently reaches the host as a one-channel stream. The second microphone cannot be recovered from that mono recording.

Two microphone signals both contain every audible person; microphone indices are not speaker identities. Multiple meeting participants can be diarized from one channel, while overlapping content is much harder.

The current pipeline crosses mono boundaries in capture selection, codec/header/profile, import-ASR derivative and model commands. Changing one model or merely changing channels metadata cannot implement dual-mic separation.
Existing raw synchronous pair observation demonstrates a possible independent capture boundary on historical hardware; it is a finite diagnostic, not continuous stereo storage or product delivery.
Perfect downstream activity zeroing tested this morning is not internally guided spatial source separation. Its negative result does not disprove GSS or a multi-channel redesign.

Archived layout estimate is approximately31.8mm between component centers, not a measured current acoustic-port distance. Near spacing supplies limited angular diversity and front/back ambiguity; two microphones do not guarantee separation of3+simultaneous speakers.

architecture.contract: Immutable original paired channels, common sample grid/channel IDs, recorded clock/geometry/calibration and codec identity. No early downmix or independent nonlinear phase-changing preprocessing.

Global anonymous people and overlapping activity intervals/confidence from voice identity plus available spatial cues. Preserve uncertainty; do not require a perfect hard decision or equate direction to a real identity.

Nonoverlap may use the original reference channel. Overlap uses the activity estimate inside multi-channel separation/beamforming; preserve original samples and provenance. GSS-style training-free reference first, subject to actual two-channel benefit.
Feed each extracted target to the protected existing recognizer. Retain raw outputs; align globally to reconcile speaker/lane permutations and timing. A fixed output lane is not a permanent person.

Reuse stable shared Document; attach time/person/source evidence for minutes and roles. Unconfirmed names/roles remain unconfirmed. Model implementations stay replaceable and separate from recording/management/UI.

refactorScope: Capture paired frames once, retain both with common sequence/sample offset; measure actual second-channel DSP/codec CPU,stack,RAM and energy before continuous firmware enablement.

Version the mono-only storage/transport/codec contract; preserve old sessions/clients. Distinguish sample frames from interleaved sample elements, retain both channels through gaps/reconnect and exact segment recovery.
Keep original multi-channel assets distinct from the mono ASR derivative in both host backends; expose one channel-aware model-independent input contract.
Evaluate original PCM before compressed dual input. Measure whether codec preserves useful phase and delay; ordinary low-bitrate stereo may erase the information that spatial separation needs.
Keep existing mono path available; any dual candidate must improve per-person errors without harming ordinary speech. No default switch or firmware installation before this evidence.

resourceTradeoff.note: Two16kbpsstreams are14.4MB/h before framing versus7.2MB/h mono. With16MiB NOR, two-hour offline retention cannot be assumed. Codec choice, compression, storage and real-time transfer require joint evaluation; CPU and battery cost are not inferred from these byte calculations.

historicalSpatialEvidence.meaning: In that old isolated-playback setup the two source spatial signatures were nearly identical in a limited stable band. No geometry or true simultaneous-person proof. Do not repeat fixed FIR/null tuning or call it a universal dual-mic impossibility.

sourceAudit.finding: PDM pair has two channels; ordinary callback emits mono; separate synchronous pre-beamforming pair observer is optional.
LEFT/RIGHT/average/beamform choices emit a single selected stream. Raw pair observer can expose both only before this reduction.
Uncalibrated normal voice and meeting profiles select LEFT and selected_only when no pair observer is attached.
opus_encoder_init channels=1 and COP header channels=1. Normal16k mode is16kbps; changing a header cannot create a spatial recording.
APM1 prelude encodes/requires one output channel; filtered_mask=3 describes processing provenance, not two stored audio channels.
Original import is retained. ASR derivative is downmixed and may invert a strongly anti-correlated right channel. This derivative must not be reused as the phase-preserving spatial input.
Current mobile ASR path validates16k mono. This is the complete recovered Android backend, not the old incomplete software050 Android tree.
Standalone model provider currently accepts only normalized16k mono.
Existing stable shared Document is a suitable downstream boundary; channel-aware input can evolve independently of UI/minutes output.

primaryReferences.relevance: Multi-channel original recording plus RTTM speaker boundaries -> per-target enhancement. Uses speaker activity inside CACGMM/GSS and beamforming, not merely zeroing audio outside annotated intervals. A training-free reference architecture; not yet verified on our two close microphones.
Reproducible GSS/ASR recipes for AMI,AliMeeting,LibriCSS; microphone-count and context dependence mean multi-mic results cannot be copied to our dual-mic device.
Diarization -> channel selection/GSS -> ASR is an established full pipeline. Its Pyannote/CuPy installation is not an automatic choice for this machine or existing model defaults.
Inter-channel correlation/phase can improve continuous meeting separation; separation-first CSS remains an alternative architecture, not a new checkpoint being run here.
Documents an example40mm two-mic linear array and amplitude/phase/port matching. These are Microsoft Audio Stack recommendations, not universal pass/fail limits or proof our device meets them.
Two-mic directional beamforming is feasible under a specified geometry/calibration. A fixed-direction virtual microphone is not a complete multi-speaker meeting separator.

CELT intensity stereo discards left/right differences in selected bands. A stereo channel count or audible stereo alone does not prove spatial information survives coding; compare decoded spatial separation to original PCM first.

GSS author GPU path uses CuPy; current AMD support is experimental and includes eigen-solver limitations. Windows RX6800XT with working PyTorch does not establish native CuPy/GSS compatibility. No driver/CUDA install is triggered.

newImplementation.scope: Independent research input preserves per-microphone PCM and sample positions. No neural call, downmix, polarity change or product backend installation.

hardwareBoundary.scope: Other ordinary long recording continues unchanged. No claim that an old capture UID proves current assembled microphone geometry or current paired capture.

validationOrder: First preserve independent synchronous raw channels; validate clipping, channel order, gain/polarity, clock drift and actual acoustic geometry.

Use matched real meetings for single-channel versus exactly two-channel comparison. If public array geometry differs, report it as algorithm evidence only; current-board two-person overlap remains necessary.
Keep predicted-activity end-to-end result separate from an explicitly labeled oracle-activity diagnostic; activity must influence spatial mask/beamforming, not reference word selection.
Report per-person word errors and omissions, speaker confusion, duplication, short turns and true2/3+overlap, plus ordinary speech regression and actual CPU/RAM/time.
Only a reproducible short gain triggers full independent meetings and then Windows/Android/card integration. Original strict<5% and minutes-fact/sale gates remain open.
next: 继续原RM-OVERLAP，优先验证“保留双麦原音→说话人活动→引导式空间分离→逐人转写”的最小真实会议对照。已完成双路无损研究输入；先建立恰好两路、同步/几何明确的公开会议输入并与单路公平比较，GSS参考实现需先解决本机轻量数值执行可行性。当前实板长录期间不占用或重刷，后续在正常空闲边界补当前实板双人重叠样本。看到逐人实际收益后才推进双声道固件/格式/双端整体重构，不把研究入口完成当效果合格。
